title: HANRIA action outcome

clause.description: Identifier of the clause that decided. Present whenever a clause matched.

clause_note.description: The clause's note, carried verbatim so a reviewer sees why the clause exists.

action_digest.description: Digest of the action request this outcome was produced for. Present whenever a request was evaluated; absent on an error raised before any request was considered, such as an unreadable or non-conforming mandate. A recorder must refuse to store an outcome that lacks it or whose digest names a different action.

$comment: An outcome is a local decision record. There is no signature, no verifier and no third-party acceptance: do not present one as evidence that an action was authorized.
